title: Zero groups, empty groups, one group

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Three trays, four cookies on each. Three groups of four make twelve.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Take one cookie from every tray.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Three groups of three. Nine cookies.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Again. Three groups of two. Six cookies.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Again. Three groups of one. Three cookies.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Take the last cookie from every tray.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The trays are there, but every group is empty.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Three groups of zero. Zero cookies!

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Yes. We count cookies, not trays.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Put back four cookies on each tray.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: This time, take away a whole tray. Two groups of four. Eight.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Another tray leaves. One group of four. Four.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One group gives exactly the cookies on that tray.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The last tray leaves. Zero groups of four. How many cookies?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Four?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Where would those four cookies be?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: There are no trays! So there are zero cookies.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Zero groups means nothing to count.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Here is one tray of seven. What does the one count?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: One tray. There are seven cookies.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: And here are seven trays, with one cookie on each.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Count one for each tray: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Seven groups of one make seven.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The pictures are different, but both have seven cookies.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Empty trays, or no trays. Different pictures of zero cookies.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One in each group? Count one cookie for every tray.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Zero groups or empty groups make zero. One group is just the group.
